blocks.text: ChatGPT is an AI assistant made by OpenAI. You can use it for free on a computer (website chatgpt.com) or on your phone (the ChatGPT app from Google Play).

items: Open chatgpt.com or install the ChatGPT app.
Sign in with your email or a Google, Microsoft or Apple account.
Confirm your account (email or code), if asked.
Done – you'll see an empty box for your message.

blocks.text: ChatGPT is for people aged 13+; under 18 you need a parent's permission.
Tap the message box, type what you need and send it. Write like you would to a smart colleague: normal sentences, with details.
Hi! I'm a beginner. In 3 short points, tell me what you can do for me in everyday life.

items: The free version has a limited number of messages; paid plans give you more.
For a new topic, start a new chat – answers stay clearer.
You can continue the conversation: ask a follow-up or ask it to change the answer.
The app's look changes over time, but the message box is always there.

blocks.text: ChatGPT has many extra features – for example it can create images and you can talk to it by voice.
